phase: Phase 1.2.c — Emergency Guardrail Production Integration Proposal and Readiness Design
author: Antigravity AI Assistant & Engineering Auditor

deliverables.description: Comprehensive integration readiness report, executive summary, findings, and release recommendations.
Detailed architectural map of current MediScanAI request lifecycle from FastAPI to database persistence.
Evaluation of pre-generation, post-generation, and two-stage hybrid alternatives with architectural rationale.
Formal interface specification defining input, output, operational constraints, and privacy contracts.
Failure Mode and Effects Analysis covering all 10 explicit operational, exception, and boundary cases.
Specification for EMERGENCY_GUARDRAIL_ENABLED, startup validation, zero-downtime rollback, and bypass prevention.
Test matrix covering 19 clinical and operational scenarios with automation and clinical review criteria.
Measurable release gates (9 engineering verified, 2 governance pending) required prior to production release.
Isolated reference implementation of IntegratedEmergencyGuardrail and middleware wrapper.
Automated unit test suite verifying feature flag, fast-path, contradictory advice elimination, and fail-safe fallback.
Machine-readable experiment manifest, invariant checks, and file inventory.

required_next_approval: Clinical Safety Review Sign-off by Board-Certified Physician
